Cuttings settle. The bore pays for it.
Every time you stop to make a connection, cuttings start dropping. They pack around the rods. Next thing you're cleaning out instead of drilling.

The fix is a fluid that gels when the pump stops. Holds everything in place until you start again. When you pump, it flows clean and carries the cuttings out.

That's what a carrier polymer does. It works while you drill and while you don't. Less clean-outs, less stuck pipe, less time wasted on problems the fluid should have prevented.

Carry Flow does this job in 6 of our 9 standard fluid programs. 1 to 6 kg per 1000L depending on the ground.
What ground gives your fluid the hardest time? Drop it below.

Carry Flow. The one product in almost every program.
Coated xanthan gum. You pour it through the hopper and it disperses clean. No lumps, no wasted product sitting in clumps at the bottom of the tank.

Works in fresh water, salt water, or brine. One product for any make-up water on any job.

It gels when you stop pumping and flows when you start. Cuttings stay suspended. The bore stays clean.

1 to 6 kg per 1000L. Start mid-range for most jobs. For tougher ground or heavier cuttings, give one of our team a call. We'll dial in the right program.
Running a job that needs a fluid program sorted? Call us.
